title: E0024: Lines of Code per Method
plain_english: Reports concrete methods whose body exceeds the configured line-count threshold.
why_matters: Long methods are harder to read, test, and change safely. Splitting a method into smaller, focused methods usually makes behavior easier to understand and reuse.
what_it_checks: Concrete method bodies in classes, traits, and enums.
Lines of code are counted as `end_line - start_line - 1` for the method body.
A method is reported when its LOC is greater than `max_loc`.
